import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static int r, c, n, i;
    static char[] s;
    static long[][] comb;
    static int[] cnt_a, cnt_b;
    static List<Long>[] partial, partial_zero;

    static void compute_comb() {
        comb = new long[n + 1][n + 1];
        for (i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            comb[i][0] = 1;
            for (int j = 1; j <= i; j++) {
                comb[i][j] = comb[i - 1][j - 1] + comb[i - 1][j];
            }
        }
    }

    static long get_difs(int conf, int a_bef, int b_bef) {
        long ans = 0;
        long aux1, aux2;
        for (int i = 0; i <= c; i++) {
            if ((conf & (1 << i)) != 0) {
                // here comes a B
                b_bef++;
                aux1 = comb[b_bef - 1][r - 1];
                aux2 = comb[n - b_bef][r] - comb[a_bef][r];
                ans -= aux1 * aux2;
            } else {
                // here comes an A
                a_bef++;
                aux1 = comb[a_bef - 1][r - 1];
                aux2 = comb[n - a_bef][r] - comb[b_bef][r];
                ans += aux1 * aux2;
            }
        }
        return ans;
    }

    static boolean check(int conf) {
        for (int i = 0; i <= c; i++) {
            if (s[2 * r + c + i] == 'A' && ((conf >> i) & 1) == 1) return false;
            if (s[2 * r + c + i] == 'B' && ((conf >> i) & 1) == 0) return false;
        }
        return true;
    }

    static void compute_second_part() {
        int limit = 1 << (c + 1);
        for (int conf = 0; conf < limit; conf++) {
            int b_here = Integer.bitCount(conf);
            int a_here = c + 1 - b_here;
            if (check(conf))
                partial[a_here].add(get_difs(conf, r + c - a_here, r + c - b_here));
            else
                partial_zero[a_here].add(get_difs(conf, r + c - a_here, r + c - b_here));
        }
        for (int i = 0; i <= c + 1; i++) {
            Collections.sort(partial[i]);
            Collections.sort(partial_zero[i]);
        }
    }

    static long get_coef(int conf) {
        int i, j;
        for (i = 0; i <= c; i++) {
            if (((conf >> i) & 1) != (conf & 1))
                break;
        }
        for (j = i; j <= c; j++) {
            if (s[2 * r - 1 + j] == 'A' && (((conf >> j) & 1) == 1)) return 0;
            if (s[2 * r - 1 + j] == 'B' && (((conf >> j) & 1) == 0)) return 0;
        }
        int set_a = r - 1 + ((conf & 1) == 0 ? i : 0);
        int set_b = r - 1 + ((conf & 1) == 1 ? i : 0);
        if (set_a < cnt_a[2 * r - 2 + i]) return 0;
        if (set_b < cnt_b[2 * r - 2 + i]) return 0;
        int total = set_a + set_b - cnt_a[2 * r - 2 + i] - cnt_b[2 * r - 2 + i];
        return comb[total][set_a - cnt_a[2 * r - 2 + i]];
    }

    static void upd(long[] ans, long[] act) {
        if (act[0] < 0) act[0] = -act[0];
        if (ans[0] < act[0]) return;
        if (ans[0] > act[0]) {
            ans[0] = act[0];
            ans[1] = act[1];
            return;
        }
        ans[1] += act[1];
    }

    static long how_many(List<Long> data, long val) {
        int lower = Collections.binarySearch(data, val);
        if (lower < 0) lower = -lower - 1;
        int upper = Collections.binarySearch(data, val);
        if (upper < 0) upper = -upper - 1;
        else {
            // move upper to the position after last occurrence
            int temp = upper;
            while (temp < data.size() && data.get(temp) == val) temp++;
            upper = temp;
        }
        return upper - lower;
    }

    static long compute_first_part() {
        int limit = 1 << (c + 1);
        long[] ans = {Long.MAX_VALUE, 0};
        for (int conf = 0; conf < limit; conf++) {
            int b_here = Integer.bitCount(conf);
            int a_here = c + 1 - b_here;
            long act = get_difs(conf, r - 1, r - 1);
            long coef = get_coef(conf);
            int idx = c + 1 - a_here;
            List<Long> partialList = partial[idx];
            List<Long> partialZeroList = partial_zero[idx];

            int pos = Collections.binarySearch(partialList, -act);
            if (pos < 0) pos = -pos - 1;
            else {
                // find last occurrence
                int temp = pos;
                while (temp < partialList.size() && partialList.get(temp) == -act) temp++;
                pos = temp;
            }
            if (pos < partialList.size()) {
                long val = partialList.get(pos);
                if (Math.abs(val + act) <= ans[0]) {
                    long count = how_many(partialList, val);
                    long[] newAns = {Math.abs(val + act), coef * count};
                    upd(ans, newAns);
                }
            }
            if (pos > 0) {
                long val = partialList.get(pos - 1);
                if (Math.abs(val + act) <= ans[0]) {
                    long count = how_many(partialList, val);
                    long[] newAns = {Math.abs(val + act), coef * count};
                    upd(ans, newAns);
                }
            }

            // coef is 0
            long coefZero = 0;
            List<Long> pz = partial_zero[idx];
            int posZero = Collections.binarySearch(pz, -act);
            if (posZero < 0) posZero = -posZero - 1;
            else {
                int temp = posZero;
                while (temp < pz.size() && pz.get(temp) == -act) temp++;
                posZero = temp;
            }
            if (posZero < pz.size()) {
                long val = pz.get(posZero);
                long count = how_many(pz, val);
                if (Math.abs(val + act) <= ans[0]) {
                    long[] newAns = {Math.abs(val + act), coefZero * count};
                    upd(ans, newAns);
                }
            }
            if (posZero > 0) {
                long val = pz.get(posZero - 1);
                long count = how_many(pz, val);
                if (Math.abs(val + act) <= ans[0]) {
                    long[] newAns = {Math.abs(val + act), coefZero * count};
                    upd(ans, newAns);
                }
            }
        }
        return ans[1];
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        r = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        c = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        s = br.readLine().toCharArray();
        n = 2 * (r + c);

        compute_comb();

        cnt_a = new int[n + 1];
        cnt_b = new int[n + 1];
        for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            cnt_a[i] = cnt_a[i - 1] + (s[i - 1] == 'A' ? 1 : 0);
            cnt_b[i] = cnt_b[i - 1] + (s[i - 1] == 'B' ? 1 : 0);
        }

        partial = new ArrayList[c + 2];
        partial_zero = new ArrayList[c + 2];
        for (i = 0; i <= c + 1; i++) {
            partial[i] = new ArrayList<>();
            partial_zero[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }

        compute_second_part();
        long sol = compute_first_part();

        System.out.println(sol);
    }
}
